claims: Small synthetic set: results describe THIS set only and are not a statistical estimate of production accuracy.
limitations: Synthetic config-derived scenarios; model-assisted authoring, NOT human review. Author had seen v2 results and categories, no v3 output.
107 scenario families x EN/TR x real/misleading labels; observations within a family are related, not independent.
